claims.text: go_router's redirect is a GoRouterRedirect callback; Đơn Hàng uses the top-level one, given to the GoRouter constructor, which is called before any navigation event and returns a new location, or null to keep the requested one.
claims.source_hint: go_router 16.3.0 doc/redirection.md (Top-level vs route-level redirection; 'return null or the original route path')

claims.text: state.matchedLocation is the matched location (e.g. /orders/1); router.dart's redirect returns '/login' when ref.read(authProvider) is null and matchedLocation starts with '/orders', else null.

claims.text: router.dart lines 17-19 create authChanges, a ValueNotifier<String?> (a Listenable), copy each new token into it with ref.listen(authProvider, ...); line 22 passes it as refreshListenable; lines 19 and 34 dispose it and the router.
A ValueNotifier holds one value and notifies its listeners when the value is replaced with a different one; ref.listen calls its function each time the provider's value changes.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: ValueNotifier (value setter notifies when != old); riverpod.dev docs: ref.listen

claims.text: OrderDetailScreen has no sign-in check of its own; DonHang.Api answers 401 to GET /api/v1/orders/{id} without a token ([Authorize]) and 403 to a customer who does not own the order (OrderOwner policy).
The guard only spares the customer a screen that would fail; the API must check anyway because anyone can call it without the app.

In a new tab signed out, pasting http://localhost:8081/orders/1 ends at http://localhost:8081/login with the Sign in with Keycloak button (Đăng nhập bằng Keycloak in a Vietnamese browser); /products/3 opens with no redirect.
